title: AiVanceSkill
description: Granular skill node in the career taxonomy, defining competency category, verified proficiency, empirical evidence references, and depth of experience.

id.description: Unique identifier for this skill node (UUID or standardized taxonomy slug)

name.description: Canonical name of the skill (e.g., 'Kotlin Coroutines', 'Distributed Consensus')

category.description: High-level classification in the career taxonomy

proficiency.description: Assessed or self-attested level of mastery

yearsOfExperience.description: Number of years actively utilizing this skill in production or study

isVerified.description: Indicates whether the skill proficiency has been verified via audit, assessment, or interview evidence

verifiedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when skill was verified

evidenceIds.description: List of evidence identifiers linking to career-memory records, GitHub repos, assessment IDs, or interview sessions

lastUsedYear.description: Calendar year when this skill was most recently practiced

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when record was created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last record update
